evidence.title: About Wolfram|Alpha: Making the World's Knowledge Computable

name: Wolfram|Alpha
summary: Computational knowledge engine that answers natural-language questions by computation instead of web links.
description: Enter a question in plain language and get computed answers from curated data and algorithms. Topics cover mathematics, science & technology, society & culture and everyday life, each with example pages (elementary math, algebra, calculus, physics, chemistry, finance, history and more). Free to use; Pro adds step-by-step solutions, uploads of data, images and files in 60+ formats, downloadable computed data and web apps.
contains: answers natural-language queries by computation, not web search
topics: mathematics, science & technology, society & culture, everyday life, with example pages per topic
Pro: step-by-step solutions, data/image/file upload in 60+ formats, downloadable data, web apps
free tier plus Pro subscriptions for students and educators
